assertion.value: The ViNaDia Protocol was approved by the National Health Bioethics Committee of Mozambique (CNBS) under number (IRB00002657, reference Nr: 348 / CNBS / 13). The participant’s documents were stored in a secure and access-restricted location in the National Institute of Health. Parents or legal guardians of the children signed the informed consent form this document described the study objectives and clarified that participation in the study was voluntary and that refusal of participation would not result in any penalty or loss of medical care.
